تختبزون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِزُونَ (taḵtabizūna) /tax.ta.bi.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
# تُخْتَبَزُونَ (tuḵtabazūna) /tux.ta.ba.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
